battle.name: 歐克拉提德一世的篡位
battle.theater: 巴克特里亞王都巴克特拉
battle.brief: 前171年，巴克特里亞王國首都巴克特拉發生宮廷政變：歐提德模斯王朝末主德米特里一世被一名塞種騎兵刺殺，狄奧多圖斯王族後裔歐克拉提德一世被軍隊推上王位。巴軍以希臘式方陣與守城投射兵器為骨幹，單臂扭力式投石機是當時攻城守城的標準重武器，城牆射位與城門爭奪決定了篡位成敗。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 交戰的一方是希臘-巴克特里亞王國，即以巴克特里亞河谷為核心、由馬其頓-希臘征服者建立的東地中海化王國。前250年狄奧多圖斯一世趁塞琉古王朝在東方戰線吃敗仗而自立，其後由歐提德模斯一世於前230年代奪位另立王統。篡位發生在王都巴克特拉（今阿富汗巴爾赫），國土南抵興都庫什北麓與印度河上游的塔克西拉，東接塞種與大月氏的牧地，西與安息及塞琉古殘餘勢力為鄰。歐提德模斯王朝的核心武力是希臘式方陣步兵與各城守備軍，德米特里一世頭銜中的「一萬人」即指首都與各城合計的常備兵。另一方並非外來軍隊，而是塞種（即塞克，Justin 筆下的「西徐亞人」）騎兵團體與王都駐軍：Justin 的《特羅古斯史綱》記載德米特里一世被一名塞克人刺殺，兇手隨即被軍中推舉的歐克拉提德取代，說明爭奪王冠的真正載體是禁衛軍、駐軍與塞種之間的同盟關係。
countriesEn: The side in the conflict was the Greco-Bactrian Kingdom, a Hellenised state built by the Macedonian-Greek conquerors around the Bactria river valley. Diodotus I had founded it in 250 BC when the Seleucid dynasty was losing ground on its eastern front, and the line was later replaced by Euthydemus I, who seized the throne in the 230s BC. The usurpation took place in the royal capital Bactra, modern Balkh in Afghanistan; the kingdom ran from the northern Hindu Kush and Taxila on the Indus in the south to the pastures of the Saka and the Yuezhi in the east, with the Parthians and the remnant Seleucid power on its western frontier. The core of the Euthydemid war machine was the Greek-style phalanx and the garrisons of the individual cities, and the ten thousand in the title of Demetrius I denoted the standing force distributed between the capital and the provincial towns. The other side was not a foreign army but the Saka, the Scythians of Justin, together with the garrison of the capital: the Epitome of Pompeius Trogus records that Demetrius I was stabbed by a Scythian and that the murderer was at once displaced by Eucratides, whom the soldiers acclaimed, which shows that the real vehicle of the contest for the crown was the alliance between the bodyguard, the garrison troops and the Saka.
people: 核心人物是歐克拉提德一世（約前171年—前145年）。Justin 說他與王室血統極近，admodum propinquus regiae stirpis，是狄奧多圖斯一家的後人，以武藝與軍功見稱；殺死德米特里一世的塞克刺殺者被這位王族取代，並由軍隊推戴為王，他因此開啟長達二十六年、並把國家重心推向東南的新王朝。被殺的德米特里一世是歐提德模斯一世之子，頭銜作「一萬人的王」；前208年其父在阿里奧斯河彎曲處以城壘抵禦塞種大軍，靠塞琉古二世派來的援軍解圍，父子兩代都靠邊防禦守而非野戰立國。真正的策劃者姓名不傳史冊，只知是一名塞克人，可能是塞種內部反對當權者的首領，趁王權交接期動手。史源方面只能依靠 Justin 的《特羅古斯史綱》第四十一卷，這部二世紀編成的節略本留下了本場政變唯一的詳細敘述。漢代文獻則從東端旁證同一地區的權力格局：《史記·大宛列傳》與《漢書·西域傳》把大宛、安息、大月氏並列在同一張歐亞內陸地圖上，而塞種正是活動在安息與大月氏之間的那股游牧力量。
peopleEn: The central figure is Eucratides I (c. 171-145 BC). Justin says that he was very close to the royal blood, admodum propinquus regiae stirpis, a descendant of the house of Diodotus, and was noted for his valour and his record in the field; the Scythian who killed Demetrius I was displaced by this kinsman of the king, who was then acclaimed king by the troops, and he thus opened a new dynasty that lasted some twenty-six years and pushed the centre of gravity of the state east and south. The murdered Demetrius I was the son of Euthydemus I and was styled king of the ten thousand; in 208 BC his father had held the bends of the Arius against a great Saka army behind the walls of a fortress and was relieved only by the reinforcements sent by Seleucus II, and both father and son founded their rule on frontier defence rather than on open battle. The name of the true plotter is not preserved: all that is known is that he was a Scythian, perhaps a Saka chieftain opposed to the ruler on the throne, who struck during the handover of power. As for the source, we are reduced to book forty-one of the Epitome of Pompeius Trogus, a second-century abridgement which preserves the only detailed account of the coup. Chinese documents bear witness from the opposite end: the Shiji chapter on Dayuan and the Han shu chapter on the Western Regions set Dawan, Anxi and the Yuezhi on one map of inner Eurasia, and the Saka were the nomadic force active between Anxi and the Yuezhi.
kits: 任務單的兵器是投石機，在希臘化世界它更常被稱為單臂扭力式投石機，希腊語作 cheiroballistra，羅馬建築師維特魯維奧在《建築十書》第十卷把這類器械記作 onager，名稱來自發射後機臂反震的模樣像野驢。它以扭力束、絞盤與槓桿把角動能轉成拋射動能，機身用木料打製、以青銅與鐵件加固，拋出石彈或鉛彈，射程可以覆蓋城牆外的空地。巴克特里亞承襲亞歷山大大軍的攻城技術，配置此類投射兵器並非罕事，波利比奧斯在公元前217年的阿羅斯圍城戰中已記錄希臘人使用單臂扭力機。城防上，巴克特拉的城牆以泥磚築成基礎、上覆燒磚，寬闊城壕與城角射位構成固定的發射陣位；攻方把投石機排成列陣對準牆段，再由方陣與攻城塔護衛接近。除投射兵器外，巴軍標準裝備是長槍方陣的 sarissa、複合弓、鐵鏃標槍、青銅盔與希臘式胸甲；塞種人則以大批輕騎游射與裝甲騎兵見長，雙方在城郊野地遭遇時，投射兵器與弓手的密度直接決定戰果。
kitsEn: The weapon in the task sheet is the onager, in the Hellenistic world more often called the single-arm torsion catapult, Greek cheiroballistra, which the Roman architect Vitruvius describes in the tenth book of De architectura as an onager, the name coming from the recoil of the arm that makes the machine look like a wild ass. It converts angular momentum into the momentum of the shot by means of twisted skeins, windlasses and levers; the frame is made of timber reinforced with bronze and iron, and it throws stone or lead shot far enough to sweep the ground outside the walls. Bactria had inherited the siege technology of the army of Alexander, so such engines were not unusual in its arsenal: Polybius already records the use of single-arm torsion engines by the Greeks in the siege of Aros in 217 BC. On the defensive side, the walls of Bactra were built with a mud-brick core and a fired-brick facing, and the broad ditch together with the corner positions of the circuit gave the firing engines their fixed emplacements; on the attacking side the engines were ranged in batteries against a chosen stretch of wall, and the phalanx and the siege towers covered the approach. Apart from the artillery, the standard kit of the Bactrian army was the sarissa of the long pike phalanx, the composite bow, the iron-shaken javelin, the bronze helmet and the Greek corselet; the Saka were famous for masses of light horse skirmishers and for armoured cavalry, and when the two sides met in the open outside the city, the density of the artillery and of the archers settled the engagement.
tactics: 這場衝突本身是王都內部的宮廷與營地行動，沒有留下陣地戰記載，戰術只能從兩個方向推斷。其一是城防體系：巴克特拉依希臘城邦樣式築造，方形城郭、棋盤街道、與城牆同高的內部平台，守軍把單臂投石機架在內牆與城角的射位上，以拋射角度覆蓋城門前的開闊地，弓手與標槍手在牆頭壓制接近的雲梯與攻城塔；一旦刺殺者的同黨要奪門，發射陣位就是關鍵。其二是塞種的機動戰法：塞克騎兵不列密集陣，而以縱隊游射、逼近後再退，反覆扯動守軍的射界，等待對方投射兵器因連續操作而疲勞或失準，再以密集騎群衝擊城門。前208年歐提德模斯一世在阿里奧斯河彎曲處的防禦就是同一邏輯的先例：他把軍隊安置在河道彎折與高地之間，拒絕與塞種在開闊地打野戰，靠地形換取投射兵器與方陣的射界，直到塞琉古的騎兵援軍到達才迫使敵人退走。補給線沿巴克赫河谷與通往天山南麓的商道維持，攻城機械的石彈取自河階碎石，繩索與青銅件靠雙峰駱駝隊運入。
tacticsEn: The conflict itself was a palace and camp action inside the capital, and no record of a field battle survives, so the tactics can only be reconstructed along two lines. The first is the defensive system: Bactra was built on the Greek model of the polis, with a square circuit of walls, a chequerboard street plan and an internal terrace level with the ramparts; the garrison mounted the single-arm torsion engines on the inner wall and at the corner positions, so that their arc of fire covered the open ground in front of the gates, while archers and javelin-throwers on the parapet beat down the ladders and the towers brought up against the masonry; if the conspirators meant to seize a gate, the engine positions were the decisive point. The second is Saka mobile warfare: the Scythian horse did not fight in a close formation but in columns that shot and withdrew, repeatedly disturbing the field of fire of the defenders, waiting until the enemy engines grew tired from continuous operation or lost their accuracy, and only then charging the gates with a dense mass of horsemen. The defence of the bends of the Arius fought by Euthydemus I in 208 BC follows the same logic: he posted his troops between the bend of the river and rising ground, refused to meet the Saka in the open, and bought the range of his engines and phalanx with the lie of the land until the cavalry of the Seleucid relief arrived and forced the enemy to withdraw. Supply ran along the valley of the Balkh and along the caravan road to the southern foot of the Tian Shan; the stone shot of the engines was quarried from the river terraces, and the ropes and the bronze fittings were brought in on two-humped camel trains.
data: 關於數字，古代記載留下的極少。Justin 唯一具體的兵力數字來自二十多年前那場塞種戰爭：塞琉古二世派給歐提德模斯一世的援軍是一萬名騎兵與五百名步兵，即 decem milia equitum, quingentos pedites；塞種圍軍的規模只寫成「大軍」而無數目。城下的常備兵以「一萬」為量級，這正是德米特里一世頭銜的來源。歐克拉提德一世的在位時間約二十六年，傳統紀年把篡位放在前171年，戰爭列表則繫於前170年。希臘-巴克特里亞王國存在約前250年至前125年；前190年馬格尼沙之戰後羅馬對塞琉古東部的重劃，以及塞琉古與安息在前二世紀末的拉鋸，都改變了它的外部環境。歐克拉提德一世是唯一同時用希臘文與迦什提字母巴克特里亞語鑄幣的印歐-希臘君主，錢幣上出現雷霆盾徽與大王字樣，是其統治範圍與雙語並存的硬證。地理上，巴克特拉位於北緯三十六度七分、東經六十六度五十分左右，阿伊哈努姆在其西南直線距離約二百五十公里處，是其屬地圈的極西端。
dataEn: Very little survives in the way of numbers, and what there is comes from Justin. The only specific strength figure comes from the Saka war of a generation earlier: the relief sent by Seleucus II to Euthydemus I was ten thousand horsemen and five hundred foot soldiers, decem milia equitum, quingentos pedites; the size of the Saka besieging army is given only as a great host, with no number attached. The permanent garrison of the capital is of the order of ten thousand, which is where the title of Demetrius I comes from. The reign of Eucratides I lasted about twenty-six years; the traditional chronology puts the usurpation in 171 BC, while the list of wars files it under 170 BC. The Greco-Bactrian Kingdom existed from about 250 to about 125 BC, and the redrawing of the Seleucid east by Rome after the battle of Magnesia in 190 BC, together with the running conflict between the Seleucids and the Parthians in the late second century BC, altered the environment in which it sat. Eucratides I was the only Indo-Greek monarch to strike coins in Greek and in Bactrian written in the Kharosthi script; the thunderbolt on a shield and the title of Great King appear on his issues and are hard evidence for the reach of his rule and for its bilingual character. Geographically Bactra lies at about 36.7 degrees north and 66.85 degrees east, and Ai-Khanoum is some 250 kilometres away in a straight line to the south-west, the western limit of his dependencies.
cause: 起因可以分成三層。第一層是王朝斷裂：德米特里一世是歐提德模斯王朝的末子，他靠父輩留下的城防與萬人常備軍維持王位；前208年守住阿里奧斯河之後，巴克特里亞在國際上只是塞琉古一個被遺忘的附庸，當塞琉古在安息與羅馬的雙重壓力下退場，巴克特里亞失去了可以依附的強權屏障，王室的正統性成了唯一剩下的抵押品。第二層是塞種壓力：塞克人自前二世紀起不斷越過錫爾河與阿姆河下來，逐步佔據河中地區的草場與城邑，邊防軍成了國家財政的主要負擔，也成了任何一個握有兵權的人最現成的資本。第三層是血統與軍功的自我宣稱：歐克拉提德一世並非王位繼承人，他靠狄奧多圖斯家族的親屬身分與長期軍功取得軍隊的認可，再用一次成功的刺殺把政治風險降到最低——殺人者不是王室成員，兇手又隨即被處置，於是王權轉移被說成是全軍的選擇，而不是一次陰謀。
causeEn: The causes can be set out in three layers. The first is the rupture of the dynasty: Demetrius I was the last son of the Euthydemid line, and he held the throne on the inherited walls and on the standing army of ten thousand; after the stand at the bends of the Arius in 208 BC, Bactria was internationally nothing more than a forgotten client of the Seleucids, and once the Seleucid monarchy was pushed back by the Parthians and by Rome, Bactria lost the shield of a great power to shelter under, and the legitimacy of the royal house became the only collateral left to pledge. The second is Saka pressure: from the early second century BC the Scythians kept coming down across the Syr Darya and the Amu Darya, taking over the pastures and the towns of the middle course, and the frontier garrisons became the main burden on the treasury and, at the same time, the most ready capital for any man with soldiers. The third is the self-claim of blood and service: Eucratides I was not the heir, and he used his standing as a kinsman of the Diodotid house and his long record of service to win the recognition of the army, then reduced the political risk to the minimum with a single successful assassination: the killer was not a member of the royal house, and the killer was disposed of at once, so that the transfer of the crown could be presented as the choice of the whole army rather than as a plot.
impact: 短期看，歐提德模斯王朝在巴克特里亞斷絕，希臘-巴克特里亞國家的政權回到狄奧多圖斯血統手中，國家沒有解體，邊界也沒有因政變而移動；這正是它的重要之處：中亞的希臘城邦國家往往因王位爭端而瓦解，這裡的繼承卻是在原有疆界與官僚體系之內完成的。中期看，歐克拉提德把重心放到東方與東南方：他的錢幣並用希臘文與巴克特里亞語，是唯一在印歐語世界實行雙語王權表述的印歐-希臘君主，這套制度後來被印度-希臘諸王沿用，直到巴克特里亞本身在塞種與安息的雙重壓力下崩解才告終。長期看，他的上台改變了與塞種的關係次序：王朝的創建者曾靠塞琉古的騎兵解圍，新的王朝卻靠塞克人的刀取得王位，此後巴克特里亞的每一次對塞種用兵都帶著王權合法性的政治負擔，與純粹的邊防反擊不同。他也把巴克特里亞重新拉回大國博弈：前141年左右他率軍西征安息，一度攻入蘇薩並自稱大王，此舉引來米特里達二世反攻，前145年巴克特里亞人退出蘇薩。
impactEn: In the short term the Euthydemid line was extinguished in Bactria and the government of the Greco-Bactrian state returned to the blood of Diodotus; the state itself was not interrupted and no frontier moved as a result of the coup, and that is the important point, because the Hellenistic city-states of Central Asia usually disintegrated when the crown was disputed, whereas here the succession was completed inside the existing borders and administrative apparatus. In the middle term Eucratides shifted the weight of the state east and south: his coins carry Greek and Bactrian side by side, and he is the only Indo-Greek monarch to run a bilingual kingship in the Indo-European world, a system later inherited by the Indo-Greek kings until the collapse of Bactria itself under the double pressure of the Saka and the Parthians. In the long term his accession reordered the relations with the Saka: the founder of the dynasty had been saved by Seleucid cavalry, whereas the new dynasty took the throne with a Scythian knife, and from then on every Bactrian campaign against the Saka carried the political burden of the legitimacy of the kingship, which was something quite different from a plain frontier counter-attack. He also pulled Bactria back into the play of the great powers: around 141 BC he campaigned west against the Parthians, entered Susa for a time and called himself Great King, which drew Mithridates II into the counter-offensive, and in 145 BC the Greeks abandoned Susa.
result: 結局是德米特里一世死在巴克特拉的宮廷或營地，刺殺他的塞克人隨即被除掉，歐克拉提德一世以「一萬人之王」的名義被軍隊推戴，在巴克特拉即位，開啟前171年至前145年約二十六年的統治。史書留下的記錄極簡：《特羅古斯史綱》只用了兩三句話記錄刺殺與篡位，沒有戰役、沒有雙方兵力、沒有勝負判定，因此這場戰爭在編年上是個空白點，只能從繼承者的名號、貨幣、築城痕跡與後續的外交方向去反推。從結果看，巴克特里亞的希臘王國在政變後完整延續，北方邊界仍由塞種的游牧集團構成威脅，西方則安息坐大；歐克拉提德把國家帶回了與安息爭奪美索不達米亞與伊朗高原的戰略位置，但這個位置最終證明是沉重的：他死後不久，希臘巴克特里亞的勢力退守巴克特里亞河谷，印歐-希臘的諸王國在一個半世紀內相繼崩解。
resultEn: The outcome was that Demetrius I died in the palace or the camp at Bactra, the Scythian who had stabbed him was removed at once, and Eucratides I was acclaimed by the troops under the title of king of the ten thousand, taking the throne at Bactra and beginning a reign of about twenty-six years that ran from 171 to 145 BC. The record is thin to the point of being silent: the Epitome of Pompeius Trogus spends two or three sentences on the murder and the usurpation, with no battle, no opposing strengths and no verdict on the result, so that this war is a blank in the chronicle and can only be read back out of the successor's titles, his coinage, the remains of the fortifications and the direction of his later foreign policy. In practical terms the Hellenic kingdom of Bactria carried on unbroken after the coup; the northern frontier was still made up of the nomadic Saka powers, and the Parthians grew strong in the west. Eucratides brought the state back into the strategic position of contesting Mesopotamia and the Iranian plateau with the Parthians, but that position proved to be a heavy one: not long after his death the Greek Bactrians were pushed back into the valley of the Balkh, and the Indo-Greek kingdoms unraveled one after another within a century and a half.
